# T-2: Classify schema tooling failures

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Route impl-review schema violations through existing bounded tooling retries and return field-complete non-semantic failure diagnostics after exhaustion.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Schema failures retry only within existing provider and flow-side limits.
- Exhaustion returns all five diagnostic fields with current attempt equal to maximum attempts.
- Invalid output does not mutate semantic counters, findings, artifacts, or step state.

## Implementation Notes
Extend the existing ReviewFailure class and run-review retry boundary rather than introducing an object-literal failure union or changing registry hooks.

## Test Strategy
Add ReviewFailure, subprocess marker, bounded-attempt, no-artifact, and no-counter unit/integration tests.
